purpose: Teach: 大笑い/ぱっと/ぺん/愛犬/老化/タメ/木製/無茶

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、彼のジョーク、私たち、大笑いしたよね、本当に、面白い人なの、彼。
lines.en: Aoi, that joke of his had us both laughing so hard. He really is funny.
lines.style: Warm, effusive delivery. Opens with affectionate ease. Light, conversational pace. Shares the memory like inviting someone into a moment of joy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お客様、店に入って、ぱっと、笑顔になる、その瞬間が、好きなのよ、葵で。
lines.en: Yeah. I love that moment when a customer walks in and their whole face just lights up.
lines.style: Gentle, observant. Slight pause before the second thought — like she's noticing something she loves about her work. Tender but grounded, not theatrical.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 妹が、新しいぺんぎんのぬいぐるみ、買ったの、可愛いって、自慢してたわよ、葵にも、見せたい。
lines.en: My little sister just bought a new penguin plush. She was so proud of it — she wants to show you.
lines.style: Brightens with affection for her sister. Quick, eager rhythm. The excitement of wanting to share something small that matters. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃんの愛犬、本当に、お利口さんよね、いつ、見ても、可愛い子、心が、和むのよ、葵で。
lines.en: Your dog really is so well-behaved. Every time I see her, she just… there's something so calming about her.
lines.style: Sincere, slightly wistful. Soft pacing. The voice of someone who notices small things that bring peace. Trails gently at the end, like a sigh of contentment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、老化、気になってきたの、私、化粧品、選ぶ時、慎重になっちゃう、本当に。
lines.en: I've started worrying about getting older lately. I get really careful about what makeup I choose now.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability. Slower pace. A little hesitant — she's sharing something she's self-conscious about. Soft, without apology, just honest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 幼馴染とは、いつまでも、タメ語で、話せるって、いいわよね、メイちゃんと、葵も、ずっと。
lines.en: There's something really nice about being able to talk like equals with someone you've known forever. That's what we have.
lines.style: Warm and settled. Appreciative tone. Speaks like she's saying something she's thought about but doesn't say often. Genuine, without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店の、木製の家具、本当に、お洒落よね、温もりが、感じられて、好きなのよ。
lines.en: Your shop's wooden furniture is beautiful. There's something so warm about it — I really love being here.
lines.style: Genuinely impressed. Unhurried pace. She's noticing and naming something beautiful. Light lift of pleasure in the voice, like she's sharing a small treasure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 無茶ダイエット、しないでね、メイちゃん、葵としても、本当に、心配だからね、お互いに、健康、第一。
lines.en: Please don't do anything too extreme with diets, okay? I worry about you. Let's both just focus on staying healthy.
lines.style: Shifts to firmer, more protective. Low, intimate volume — this matters. Steady gaze in the voice. Concern grounded in care, not criticism. Ends with quiet resolve.
